description: The Weekly Pulse for one week, as JSON: what changed at The Mine (new periods, agencies' revisions, first values, values entered by hand, late and paused sources, the next checks), in fixed sentences built only from stored figures; no model writes it. Default: the latest issue. Figures are official statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Coverage labels matter: read the coverage line (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Repeat each figure's notice when you use it. Facts, not investment or other advice.

date.description: The issue's Monday, YYYY-MM-DD (Honolulu time); default the latest
